India Launches 'Operation Amistad' Relief Mission for Venezuela

India has launched a relief operation named 'Operation Amistad' to assist Venezuela following an earthquake. The operation's name, 'Amistad', meaning friendship, highlights the humanitarian gesture. This mission underscores India's commitment to international aid during crises.
